behavior: In a filterable menu, the query can hide an item whose content is the slot of a Vapor component. Such a slot gives its nodes only at a mount. The item mounts that content in an element that is not in the document, and the filter matches the text of the element. That text has the text that each component of the content renders, and the filter runs again after each change of it. The components of the content run while the item is hidden. An item with a `label` mounts no content while it is hidden. When `label` becomes `undefined` on a hidden item, the filter uses the text that the element of the item had, and not the old `label`. If the content changed while the item was hidden, the filter uses the text of the changed content. For the slot of a Vapor component, that text is the text of the mount that starts when `label` becomes `undefined`. For a virtual DOM slot, the item reads the text of the vnodes and mounts nothing, as Base UI reads the children. Base UI reads only the text in the children of the item. It does not see a change of the text that a child component renders while the item is hidden. When `label` becomes `undefined` on a hidden item, Base UI can keep the old `label` or lose the rendered text of a child component.
